title: Operations Director
description: Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab's cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production.Role Summary:As Operations Director for our holding company, Miroma, you'll lead our offshore delivery team, owning campaign performance, process and quality end-to-end, while managing and developing specialists to deliver strategy flawlessly, on time and to the highest standard within a remote-first environment.Role: Campaign Performance & DeliveryTake ultimate responsibility for the performance of all campaigns delivered by the offshore team, including pacing, delivery in full, and optimisation against agreed KPIsTranslate the strategy set by the client team into clear, actionable delivery plans for the activation teamPersonally manage or directly support campaign setup, activation and optimisation in-platform where required, particularly for complex, high-priority or new-format campaignsProactively identify challenges in setup and delivery and feed them back to the client teamIdentify performance issues proactively and lead troubleshooting and resolutionReport on campaign and team performance to leadership on a regular basisProcess, Setup & Quality AssuranceOwn and continuously improve the end-to-end process for campaign setup, activation and deliveryEstablish a robust QA framework to catch errors before they affect delivery or client-facing reporting, with particular focus on the additional risk created by a fully remote working modelDevelop clear, written standard operating procedures and best practice documentation that enable consistent delivery regardless of who on the team is executingImplement structured handover, escalation and sign-off processes appropriate to a distributed team operating across time zonesEnsure all platform, billing and compliance processes are followed accurately and consistentlyTeam Management & DevelopmentRecruit, manage, mentor and develop Activation Specialists and Analysts, setting clear objectives and providing regular feedbackBuild a strong, accountable team culture suited to remote working, with clear expectations on communication, availability and ownershipLead recruitment, onboarding and training for the offshore team as it scalesConduct regular performance reviews and support individual development plansCollaborationWork closely with the client team to ensure full alignment between strategy and deliveryProvide a clear escalation point between the offshore team and leadershipContribute operational and platform expertise to support new business proposals and product developmentYou:At least 8 years' experience in programmatic or biddable media operations, ideally within a trading desk, agency or in-house teamProven track record of managing and developing a team, including performance management and skills developmentStrong hands-on platform experience across DSPs (e.g. DV360, Quantcast, Amazon) and a willingness to remain hands-on day to dayDemonstrated experience building or significantly improving operational processes, workflow and QA standardsExperience operating effectively within a remote or distributed team structureStrong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and translate it into actionExcellent written communication skills, given the importance of clear documentation and remote collaborationExperience working with, or a strong interest in, entertainment, live events or culture sector clients is an advantageA natural leader who leads by example, comfortable balancing strategic oversight with hands-on deliveryHighly organised, with rigorous attention to detail and a thorough approach to process and qualityResilient, proactive and able to operate independently with limited day-to-day inputCalm under pressure, with strong problem-solving instincts when issues arise in-platformExceptional verbal and written English communication skillsPlease note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction
